decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's core machining offer and fits its automation strategy, and with the firm expanding and holding slack there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, so it is kept despite limited evidence of results so far.

The dual-table loading system is a low-risk automation add-on close to the established business, and the firm's growth and investment give enough slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain.

Although the dispensing machine is distant from the core business, it has its own product page and a Red Dot award, which signals performance at or above aspiration, and growth slack lets the firm keep building it.
